title: Enforce channel mediasource id
body:
A media source always needs an ID but channels are not really required to provide one.

**Changes**
* Make sure ID is set.

**Code assistance**
None

**Issues**
Fixes https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-nextpvr/issues/81
